title: Tell HN: Claude Code appends new commit signature even if older settings is off
excerpt: I have the automatic "co-authored by" Claude signature turned off for my commits via the config setting.
content_html:
I have the automatic "co-authored by" Claude signature turned off for my commits via the config setting.

PSA: They've introduced a new "Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_xyz" line that's appended to the commit now though, on by default.

Annoying, feels scummy (of all things, ironic I know)
